rules.youWrote: You wrote this version. A different doctor has to approve or reject it.
rules.withdrawTitle: Withdraw this draft red-flag rule version?
rules.withdrawBody: A withdrawn draft is closed for good. It can never be approved and it is never in force. A withdrawn version is not the same as a retired one. Only a draft can be withdrawn. To change a rule, write a new version.
rules.retireTitle: Retire this approved red-flag rule version?
rules.retireBody: Your retire decision is recorded now, and nothing is retired until a second, different doctor also records one. A retired version never comes back: a new version is the way back. If this is the newest version of its rule code, the whole rule code stops being in force.
rules.retireCount: Retire decisions recorded so far: {{count}}. Two different doctors are needed.
rules.youRetired: You have recorded your retire decision on this version.

result.retired: Your retire decision was recorded and this version is now retired.
result.withdrawn: This draft is withdrawn. It is closed for good and is not in force.
result.not_approved: This version is not approved, so it cannot be retired. Nothing was recorded.
